remarks: Great opportunity to live in the sought-after gated community of The Chesterfield in mid-city Stamford. This 1BR home features a spacious open floor plan with a large living room, an updated kitchen with granite countertops, stainless steel appliances, wine fridge, breakfast bar, and a dining area with sliders leading to a private deck and walk-out access to a grassed area, great for entertaining and easy one-level living. The oversized bedroom includes two large closets, and the renovated bathroom offers a spa-like feel. Hardwood floors, fresh paint, in-unit laundry, and ample storage complete the home. Enjoy 24-hour security, two pools, and a convenient location close to shopping, dining, parks, and entertainment. Just move right in!
